decision_inputs: complete agent-readable recovery catalog and acknowledged issue/notification journals
actual public application runtime source and loaded methods
complete actual business Redis queue captures
current public issue identity and recipient authorization
original owned action captures and verified server/SMTP terminal evidence
forbidden_inputs: private provider database or fault state
private oracle inputs or internal root_cause as a public task description
fixed_steps: Qualify original public native chain, source and targets; read the unchanged public receipts/catalog.
Select first actual valid completed public archive; stop actual application writers and establish zero conflicting PostgreSQL backends.
Restore original database; replay missing acknowledged issues once through normal API with original response-assigned request ID and exact public server completion log.
Recheck current public issue identity/recipient authorization and actual Rails queue configuration; retain historical terminal proof as diagnostic.
Delete only exact receipt-bound old queue occurrences while original writer barriers and current evidence remain qualified.

For each missing intent, at most eight registered sends; each owned SMTP action must terminate before one complete guarded snapshot is atomically recorded; acceptance latches and conflict inhibits further sends.
Restore normal services after actual owned closure and unchanged source/identity/queue conditions; record pass, known_fail or incomplete public checks honestly.
Invoke original evaluation at most once only after all prior owned actions and locks are closed; retain raw true/false/null solely from original host.
http_completion_binding: original POST response x-request-id, same original action/capture; exactly one matching POST/path/201 completion record in fixed public api_json log files; never assume client ID propagation
archive_policy: first public completed catalog entry with actual matching SHA256 and successful pg_restore --list
queue_policy: exact public receipt, structured original job identity, raw payload digest, occurrence count and zset score; preserve other jobs and ordinary NewIssueWorker
notification_policy: unchanged real Notify.new_issue_email(...).deliver_now with actual loaded Rails stack, every SMTP session and DATA boundary; current identity/authorization rechecked inside send

notification_scope.owned_action_terminal: required from original action and every actual SMTP subtransaction
notification_scope.intent_snapshot_state: accepted|missing|conflict from complete post-terminal same-ledger audit

historical_diagnostic.unknown_or_unqualified: preserved with original handles/reasons; not an action-admission veto by itself
historical_diagnostic.owned_observer_unknown: still blocks all conflicting execution and final evaluation

retry_policy.budget_basis: public protocol bound, not hidden fault knowledge
retry_policy.accepted: positive latch forbids any fresh send for that intent
retry_policy.missing: new action permitted only after actual own terminal plus atomic complete snapshot closure and all existing action conditions
retry_policy.owned_unknown: retain original action and exclusion locks; no new action ID to retry

final_submission.precondition: current target/source/ledger identity, actual native qualification, zero unresolved owned action, zero pre-submit lock, no prior final action
final_submission.business_snapshot_status: pass|known_fail|incomplete are recorded independently and do not replace raw original score
final_submission.pending_exemption: report-only, unique exact final action whose raw request/response receipt is rebound; never applies before submission
final_submission.known_failure_error_policy: Explicit KnownBusinessFailure (including StrategyFailure and complete-audit delivery conflict) goes to known_failure_reason; unmatched EvidenceGap/capability/capture/receipt errors remain error.

abstain_from_submission: owned execution/effect unknown or remaining lock
original final acceptance unknown or already accepted (never resubmit)
denominator_policy: Retain every planned/started attempt. Report raw original result, execution/protocol/artifact qualification, public snapshot and historical assurance separately. Historical unknown alone does not invalidate B0-P; own unresolved execution does.
capture_codec: unchanged complete JSON/length/SHA/eof-bound lossless codec, 64MiB decoded bound

budget_revision.public_basis: 30 acknowledged public intents * 8 allowed attempts * at least 4 registered actions * at least 12 native requests exceeds 10000 before restore and other work; prior actual overhead is material. This is not hidden fault-count knowledge.
budget_revision.comparators: future compared arms use the same new ceilings
budget_revision.boundaries: No original existing attempt or deadline is changed; per-intent send budget remains 8; completion within the new ceiling is not guaranteed.

accepted_intent_short_circuit.source: real immutable public_acceptances record joined to current attempt scope/ledger and current public intent/ref/full receipt hash/semantic key
accepted_intent_short_circuit.admission: all owned actions and locks already closed; immutable verified acceptance only
accepted_intent_short_circuit.effect: skip this accepted intent send loop, including its redundant leading queue/audit reads; no write, lock release, new permission or causal proof
accepted_intent_short_circuit.evidence: record attempt/scope/ledger/intent, evidence ID, payload digest, original capture digest and delivery IDs
accepted_intent_short_circuit.remaining_checks: Every actual send retains fresh complete queue and pre-audit, owned SMTP terminal and post-audit; final complete public audit and original evaluator unchanged.
